create.name: Becky Vollmer
create.bio:
Becky Vollmer is a yoga teacher and writer from St. Louis whose work centres on one idea: that feeling trapped in a life is rarely as fixed as it seems, and that most of us have more choice than we allow ourselves. She spent close to twenty years in newspapers, political campaigns and public relations before leaving corporate life, and she draws openly on her own changes since then, including the end of a marriage and getting sober, as she raised four children. She has practised yoga for about twenty-five years and taught it for most of that time.

Her book, You Are Not Stuck: How Soul-Guided Choices Transform Fear into Freedom, was published by St. Martin's Essentials and mixes spiritual reflection with practical steps for making a change in work, relationships or habits. She teaches live online yoga twice a week, hosts a weekly members' circle on Zoom for conversation and support, and offers a six-part recorded course called RESOLUTION. Her workshops pair gentle yoga and breathwork with journaling and honest questions about values and fear. She has led retreats at Omega and the Art of Living Retreat Center and returns to Kripalu most years for a New Year programme.

books.title: You Are Not Stuck: How Soul-Guided Choices Transform Fear into Freedom
books.author: Becky Vollmer
books.description: Becky's first book, a mix of memoir, spirituality and workbook for anyone who knows something in their life needs to change but cannot find the nerve. She walks readers through naming their values, facing the fears behind inaction and planning a first step.

courses.title: You Are Not Stuck: Soul-Guided Choices for the New Year
courses.description: A New Year programme at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, combining yoga, breath and guided reflection. Participants look at what is and isn't working, face the fears that keep them in place and leave with a plan for the year ahead; open to all levels.

courses.title: RESOLUTION On Demand
courses.description: A recorded six-module course built on Becky's own process for changing direction. Through video lessons and journal prompts it looks at why people stay put, what they truly want and how to take a first brave step.

courses.title: THE CIRCLE Weekly Zoom Gathering
courses.description: A members-only conversation group that meets with Becky on Zoom every Wednesday at noon Eastern. Sessions draw on readings, breath and shared experience around choice, spirituality and ordinary life; it is not recorded.

courses.title: Online Yoga with Becky
courses.description: Live online yoga classes on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, suitable for all levels, with recordings for members. Drop in for a single class or join monthly for live classes and the recordings library.
courses.price: $12 USD per class; memberships from $88 USD per month
